Compute restricted mean survival time (RMST) from a survival-probability matrix (survmat)

Source: R/survmat-helpers.R
survmat_to_rmst.Rd

Computes \(\mathrm{RMST}(\tau) = \int_0^\tau S(t)\, dt\) for each observation, via the trapezoidal rule on the provided time grid (delegated to tvrmst::rmst_dynamic()), followed by linear interpolation to tau when tau falls between grid points.

Usage

survmat_to_rmst(S, times, tau = max(times))

Arguments

S

A surv_mat: numeric matrix/data.frame of survival probabilities.

times

Numeric vector of time points corresponding to columns of S. Must be strictly increasing and non-negative.

tau

Positive numeric scalar; upper integration limit. Default is max(times).

Value

Numeric vector of RMST values (length = nrow(S)).

Details

If the grid does not include 0, the function prepends \((0, S(0)=1)\) to correctly integrate from time 0. When tau exceeds the last grid point, the value is held at the definite integral over the full grid (no extrapolation past the observed curve).

Examples

times <- c(1, 2, 3)
S <- matrix(c(0.9, 0.8, 0.7,
              0.95,0.9,0.85), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
colnames(S) <- paste0("t=", times)
survmat_to_rmst(S, times, tau = 3)
#> [1] 2.550 2.775
